title: Adaptive holdoff mediator and tenant fairness stabilizer
author: Samira Khan
body:
Motivation: We observed repeated reopen oscillations for small regional clusters after capacity events which caused cascade retries and SLO noise. This PR introduces a lightweight holdoff mediator that enforces an adaptive reopen backoff with region-aware rollback logic and per-tenant smoothing to reduce noisy priority flips.

Summary of changes: implement an in-node holdoff mediator that tracks a compact epoch + EWMA of recent reopen requests, apply tenant-priority smoothing to avoid aggressive preemption on short spikes, add region-aware rollback heuristics that prevent double-fallbacks across zones, and surface operational telemetry and runbook guidance. Also includes a targeted hotfix for a double-charge edge-case in the rollback path that could increment tenant penalty counters twice under race conditions.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-4721) - [x] Unit tests for holdoff mediator and EWMA smoothing - [x] Integration test for restart persistence and region rollback scenario - [x] Telemetry dashboards and alerts added - [x] Runbook update and rollout notes

Why this is different: existing SLO enforcement components focused on eviction and coarse tenant throttles; this change sits between admission and eviction and prevents feedback loops by mediating reopen attempts and smoothing priority deltas so downstream evictions are less likely to oscillate.

Implementation notes: the mediator keeps a minimal persisted state (epoch id, ewma_alpha, last_reopen_ts) in node-local metadata so restarts don't immediately re-open circuits. The EWMA smoothing uses a configurable alpha per-tenant with a safe default (0.2). Region-aware rollback inspects the last-failover vector to avoid reissuing rollback when the same tenant has already been rolled back in another zone; this prevents duplicate penalty accounting. We exposed three new counters and two gauges (holdoff_mediator_active, tenant_fairness_ewma_gap, mediator_reopen_attempts).

Testing: unit tests cover state transitions, alpha boundary conditions, and persistence; integration test simulates a transient capacity event across two zones and verifies mediator prevents reopen cascade and that metrics reflect stabilized state. CI initially failed in integration due to a timing window; probe window and jitter were adjusted and CI passed on the follow-up run.

Rollout: staged rollout recommended — enable mediator on a small canary region for 48h, monitor holdoff_mediator_active and tenant_fairness_ewma_gap, then progressively enable by region. If unexpected impact is observed, flip feature flag mediator.enabled=false; as a fallback the system reverts to previous admission behavior.

Ops notes: The runbook (docs/ops/holdoff-runbook.md) documents expected metric ranges and remediation steps. This PR also includes a short hotfix to region_failover.go to avoid double-charge under a racing rollback path.

Related: ENG-4721 (design), ENG-4850 (postmortem follow-up), incident INT-2121 referenced for context.

Implement EWMA-based tenant priority smoothing and metric hooks
Region-aware rollback decision and fix double-charge bug
Docs: add operational note and runbook section
Tests: add integration scenario for reopen oscillation
review_comments: Maya Chen: Nice approach; clarify how the mediator state is persisted across restarts — can we store minimal epoch?
Samira Khan: We persist the epoch id and EWMA state to the node-local metadata store; added test to cover restart flow.
Arjun Patel: CI failed on integration due to flakiness in probe timing — suggested increasing probe window.
Samira Khan: Increased probe window and added jitter; reran CI which passed.
Lena Sokolov: Approve after small naming nit (renamed 'smoothCoeff' -> 'smoothing_alpha').
release_notes: Stability: introduce adaptive holdoff mediator to reduce reopen oscillations and improve tenant fairness smoothing. Hotfix: prevent double-penalty on rollback races. Staged rollout recommended; alarms added for 'holdoff_mediator_active' and 'tenant_fairness_ewma_gap'.
notes_to_ops: Rolling upgrade recommended: stagger by zone; monitor metric 'holdoff_mediator_active' and 'tenant_fairness_ewma_gap'; fallback: set mediator.enabled=false via config map.
